adjudication.rationale: The diff explicitly makes `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` an array (types + multiple callsites push multiple calendars, e.g. `handleNewBooking.ts` builds an array and for COLLECTIVE does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`). However, when persisting the booking, the PR still only connects a single destination calendar: `connect: { id: evt.destinationCalendar[0].id }` (handleNewBooking.ts around the shown change). Later deferred flows rebuild `evt.destinationCalendar` from `booking.destinationCalendar` (singular) or `user.destinationCalendar` and wrap it into a single-element array (e.g. paypal-webhook.ts, webhook.ts, confirm.handler.ts, bookingReminder.ts, etc.), so those deferred executions can only ever target one destination calendar. Given `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` now loops over `event.destinationCalendar` to create multiple events, losing all but `[0]` at persistence time means paid / requires-confirmation collective bookings will only create (and thus later update/delete) the first host’s calendar event, and the rest can’t be created/cleaned up because the data isn’t stored on the booking.
